page.overview:
Who is Jie?

At some point, Jie rose to become the leader of the Denied and learnt that an ancient Avatar named Sonam had possessed the power to gift bending abilities by using an empowered staff.

Around 110 AG, Jie and her comrades tracked down a statuette of Sonam which contained a map, leading to the location of Sonam's staff. Yet the item was also discovered by Avatar Aang who was ignorant of its potential importance and brought it to a sanctuary inside one of the Southern Air Temple's towers. Jie and her followers Kallik, Hong, and Yuddah ambushed Avatar Aang at the temple, seeking to steal the statuette. Though Hong managed to take the item, it was quickly reclaimed by the Avatar. The Denied kept battling Aang until Jie became impatient and shot an explosive arrow at her opponent, seeking to kill him. However, the attack destabilized the entire tower. Amid the chaos, Aang was knocked out while saving Kallik's life. Furthermore, Sonam's statuette broke and Kallik was able to take the map within.

As Jie, Kallik, Hong and Yuddah rushed back to their airship waiting outside, the collapsing tower's upper half threatened to fall onto the vessel. Yet Aang awakened and entered the Avatar State, earthbending the tower back into place, letting Jie and her group get away.

With the map in their hands, Jie and her followers traveled across the Endless Ocean to snatch Sonam's staff. During the voyage, Kallik spotted the Avatar and the Fire Lord's airship through a telescope. Jie promptly ordered her forces to launch a surprise attack to kill their opponents. When Kallik questioned the order by pointing out how the Avatar had saved her life, Jie angrily reprimanded the younger woman by pointing out that the Avatar had failed them all and they had to gain bending powers at all costs.
